criteria.blocker: Two of the fourteen named dimensions fail at head on the frontend surface: 'frontend states' and the frontend half of 'authorization'. Both are unchanged from the prior audit; the remediation commit (backend 9534abcf9) repaired the backend P0s and left these.
criteria.clauses_failing: frontend states; authorization (frontend write surface). The other twelve dimensions (plans, subscriptions, entitlements, seats, proration, usage, immutable invoices, tax/currency, idempotent provider events, replay-safe webhooks, cached feature gates, sandbox failure tests) were re-checked and hold at head.
criteria.evidence:
FAILING CLAUSE 1 - 'frontend states'. All ten components under frontend/features/payments/components/*.tsx contain ZERO occurrences of isError; measured with `for f in features/payments/components/*.tsx; do grep -c isError $f; done` -> 0 on every file. Concretely: /Users/tarunchintakunta/Personal/streamline/streamlineos-frontend/frontend/features/payments/components/readiness-rail.tsx:8 destructures only `{ data: readiness, isLoading }` from usePaymentReadiness, and :20 `if (isLoading || !readiness)` renders a Skeleton -- so a failed or 403 read renders as a PERMANENT skeleton. /Users/tarunchintakunta/Personal/streamline/streamlineos-frontend/frontend/features/payments/components/audit-tab.tsx:8 does the same and :21 `if (!events || events.length === 0)` renders EmptyState 'No audit events yet' -- a failed read is indistinguishable from an empty one. No gate sees this shape, by the gates' own words: /tmp/feg-check_empty-states.log reads 'No hand-rolled empty states found outside EmptyState (3878 files scanned)' -- it checks that empty states use the shared component, never that an error branch exists; and /tmp/feg-check_gated-reads.log ends 'This gate certifies request suppression, NOT that a screen renders the refusal. The unread gates are an app/** and features/** change -- ticket 30, not this scanner.'

FAILING CLAUSE 2 - 'authorization' on the frontend write surface. `grep -rn 'useCan(' features/billing/` returns hits only in ai-credits-settings-page.tsx:62 and billing-profile-tab.tsx:71,72. /Users/tarunchintakunta/Personal/streamline/streamlineos-frontend/frontend/features/billing/invoices-client.tsx contains ZERO useCan/useAccess/RequireModule, yet renders Mark-issued (:99), Mark-paid (:104), a destructive Void (:109, onClick={handleMarkVoided}, no ConfirmDialog) and Create (:270). /Users/tarunchintakunta/Personal/streamline/streamlineos-frontend/frontend/app/(authenticated)/billing/invoices/new/page.tsx has no gate of its own; the only gate on that path is /Users/tarunchintakunta/Personal/streamline/streamlineos-frontend/frontend/app/(authenticated)/billing/layout.tsx:9 `await enforceRouteAccess("/billing/invoices")` -- a READ key guarding a create route. By contrast features/payments IS gated (useCan at webhooks-tab.tsx:84, provider-card.tsx:27, credentials-tab.tsx:40, test-payment-tab.tsx:35, manual-methods-panel.tsx:31, live-activation-panel.tsx:27), which is why this is a real gap rather than a house style.

CLAUSES RE-CHECKED AND NOW HOLDING (prior-audit P0/P1s repaired by 9534abcf9, verified myself at head): tax/currency -- src/modules/billing/core/billing-payment-activation.ts:202-222 `billablePrice` now takes amount AND currency from ONE source (catalogPrice, else PLAN_PRICES_PAISE + PLATFORM_PRICE_CURRENCY), closing F1; src/modules/invoices/invoices-update.service.ts:148-153 now rewrites cgst/sgst/igst alongside taxAmount from `this.posting.gstSplit(...)`, closing F2; src/modules/invoices/lib/invoice-helpers.ts:24-25 `round2` is now `Number(roundDecimal(decimalFromNumber(n), 2))` on exact BigInt arithmetic, closing F5. Replay-safe webhooks -- src/modules/billing/payments/payment-webhook-receiver.service.ts:226-234 routes the id through `resolveProviderEventId(header, normalized)` whose doc at :390-392 records that the unsigned header 'may never BE the key', closing F4; billing-webhook.handler.ts:145-152 now converges redriveUnprocessed on the same `settle()` that carries the org guard, closing F6. Immutable invoices -- migrations/0492_invoice_immutability_trigger.sql plus 0565_billing_invoice_snapshot_immutability.sql, and invoices-update.service.ts:105 refuses any edit when `existing.status !== 'DRAFT'`, so the absent invoice_items trigger is a defence-in-depth gap, not a reachable hole.

MEASURED AT HEAD: `npx jest --runInBand --testPathPattern="modules/(billing|invoices)/"` -> 56 suites passed, 2 SKIPPED, 58 total; 619 tests passed, 17 SKIPPED, 636 total; exit 0. That is up from the prior audit's 51+1 suites / 558 tests, so the remediation added 5 suites and 61 tests here. Recorded honestly: the skips are the DB-backed halves of the regression tests for the very P0s above -- src/modules/billing/payments/payment-webhook-event-id-precedence.db.spec.ts:133 `const describeDb = ENABLED && DB_URL ? describe : describe.skip` (needs BILLING_DB_TESTS=1 + a DATABASE_URL) and src/modules/invoices/__tests__/invoice-edit-gst-integrity.db.spec.ts:46 (needs INV_DB_TESTS=1). Their hermetic halves (e.g. the plain `describe` at payment-webhook-event-id-precedence.db.spec.ts:73) did run. A skip is not a pass, so the F2/F4 fixes are confirmed by source reading plus their hermetic tests, not by their database tests.

REFUTED SUB-CLAIM (recorded, does not change the verdict): reports/10-audit.md F3 asserts P0 'src/modules/accounting/posting/journal-posting.service.ts:175-192 persistJournalEntry writes POSTED entries with no balance assertion at any layer'. Untrue. `assertBalanced(draft.lines)` is the FIRST statement of persistJournalEntry at journal-posting.service.ts:92; it is defined at :73-88 and compares totalDebit/totalCredit through sumDecimals/compareDecimals, which are BigInt-scaled exact arithmetic (src/modules/accounting/core/money.util.ts:80-86,136-140). All four internal callers (:193,:215,:245,:267) route through it. `git log -3 -- src/modules/accounting/posting/journal-posting.service.ts` shows the file was not touched by the remediation commit, so the claim was false when written, not merely stale.
